_note: Dollars per million tokens (docs/plans/05-in-app-tutor.md, 'Model per task': the pricing page, 2026-10-11). The in-app tutor prices each response's usage with this table; a model it lacks is priced by its family's first entry. OpenAI's rows: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard, short context; the model pages agree), checked 2026-10-18: cached input is 'read', cache writes (1.25x input, one lifetime of at least 30 minutes) are 'write_5m' and 'write_1h' alike, prompts over 272K cost 2x input and cache and 1.5x output. With the ChatGPT plan the learner pays nothing per token: the app records these prices as the API-equivalent. Gemini's rows: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (Standard, paid tier), checked 2026-10-19: 'read' is the context-caching (implicit) price; Gemini has no cache-write charge for implicit caching, so 'write_5m' and 'write_1h' are the input price (never used: its usage reports no writes); output includes thinking tokens; a row with 'until' holds through that day, the next 'from' it (introductory prices: 4 Argon through 2026-11-30, 3.8 Flash through 2026-12-31). On the free tier the learner pays nothing per token: the app records these prices as the API-equivalent. OpenRouter's calls are priced by the cost OpenRouter reports (usage.cost); without one, by the vendor's own row.
